result.topic_en: The page looks for rational values α…ε whose numerators and denominators are 5-fold (and then 10-fold) squares. Each fraction is expressed as a signed combination of simple fractions and listed with an angle in degrees, minutes and seconds.

setze man

Man leitet daraus ab

Daraus das Endresultat
$\alpha = \frac{7}{51} = -\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2} + \frac{2}{7} + 1$ 7.48.55

Noch eine Auflösung wo Zähler u. Nenner 10 fache Quadrate

$3\alpha - 3\beta - \gamma + \delta - 3\varepsilon \mp 5.7 = 0$
